# @paperjsx/json-to-docx

Generate native Microsoft Word `.docx` files from JSON or TypeScript. Headings, paragraphs, nested lists, tables with spans, images, charts, shapes, headers/footers, footnotes, columns, TOC, and template hydration — all emitted as real OOXML.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@paperjsx/json-to-docx)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paperjsx/json-to-docx)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@paperjsx/json-to-docx)](./LICENSE)

```bash
npm install @paperjsx/json-to-docx
```

Requires Node.js `>=18`. ESM + CJS.

## Quick Start

```ts
import { renderToDocx } from "@paperjsx/json-to-docx";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const result = await renderToDocx({
  type: "DocxDocument",
  pageSize: "a4",
  pages: [
    {
      elements: [
        { type: "heading", level: 1, text: "Annual Report" },
        {
          type: "paragraph",
          text: "Revenue grew 34% year over year, driven by enterprise expansion.",
        },
        {
          type: "table",
          rows: [
            { isHeader: true, cells: [{ text: "Region" }, { text: "Revenue" }] },
            { cells: [{ text: "North America" }, { text: "$5.1M" }] },
            { cells: [{ text: "Europe" }, { text: "$3.6M" }] },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ],
});

writeFileSync("report.docx", result.buffer);
```

## Supported Elements

| Element       | Notes                                                                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `heading`     | Levels 1–6, auto-numbered or manual, used for TOC generation.              |
| `paragraph`   | Rich runs (bold / italic / underline / color / size), hyperlinks, footnote refs. |
| `list`        | Bullet, numbered, lettered, roman. Up to 9 nesting levels.                 |
| `table`       | Row/column spans, header repeat across pages, 4 built-in styles, per-cell styling. |
| `image`       | Inline or floating, wrap modes (square, tight, through, top-and-bottom), remote fetch with SSRF protection. |
| `chart`       | 8 chart types via the PVCE engine (rendered as embedded images).           |
| `shape`       | Rectangle, ellipse, triangle, diamond, line, arrow.                        |
| `code-block`  | Monospace with language hint and optional line numbers.                    |
| `divider`     | Horizontal rule.                                                            |
| `page-break`  | Force a new page.                                                           |

## Verified Schema

The canonical DOCX input surface is generated from the exported Zod schema, not maintained by hand:

- Schema reference: [`docs/schema-reference.md`](./docs/schema-reference.md)
- Verified examples: [`docs/examples.md`](./docs/examples.md)

Validate untrusted input before rendering:

```ts
import { validateDocxDocument } from "@paperjsx/json-to-docx";

const parsed = validateDocxDocument(input); // throws ZodError if invalid
const result = await renderToDocx(parsed);
```

`renderToDocx` is strict by default: after generating the DOCX package, it checks Word-sensitive OOXML invariants such as non-negative tab stops, content-type targets, and relationship references. Pass `{ strict: false }` only as a temporary migration escape hatch.

## Template Hydration

Hydrate an existing `.docx` template by replacing `{{placeholder}}` tokens with typed values. Run-split placeholders (where Word splits a token across XML runs during editing) are normalized in up to 5 passes before injection.

```ts
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { hydrateDocx, scanForPlaceholders } from "@paperjsx/json-to-docx";

const template = await readFile("invoice-template.docx");

// Inspect which placeholders exist
const placeholders = scanForPlaceholders(template);
// → ["{{customer.name}}", "{{invoice.number}}", "{{items}}", ...]

const hydrated = await hydrateDocx(template, {
  customer: { name: "Acme Corp" },
  invoice: { number: "INV-2026-042", total: "$14,400.00" },
  items: [
    { description: "Enterprise License", qty: 1, unitPrice: 12000 },
    { description: "Support Package",    qty: 1, unitPrice: 2400  },
  ],
});

await writeFile("invoice-2026-042.docx", hydrated);
```

Array placeholders expand into repeating table rows or paragraphs. Nested paths (`customer.name`) and conditional sections (`{{#if items}} … {{/if}}`) are supported.

## Tables

```ts
{
  type: "table",
  style: "grid",              // "grid" | "banded" | "borderless" | "minimal"
  columnWidths: [2000, 4000, 2000],  // twips
  rows: [
    {
      isHeader: true,
      cells: [{ text: "SKU" }, { text: "Description" }, { text: "Price" }],
    },
    {
      cells: [
        { text: "A-100" },
        { text: "Professional plan", colSpan: 1 },
        { text: "$99/mo", alignment: "right" },
      ],
    },
  ],
}
```

Header rows repeat on every page automatically. Cell `colSpan` / `rowSpan`, background colors, borders, padding, and vertical alignment are all supported.

## Charts

```ts
{
  type: "chart",
  chartType: "bar",          // bar | line | pie | scatter | area | doughnut | radar | combo
  title: "Revenue by Quarter",
  data: {
    categories: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
    series: [
      { name: "2025", values: [120, 140, 180, 210] },
      { name: "2026", values: [160, 185, 235, 280] },
    ],
  },
  width: 600, height: 360,
}
```

Charts render deterministically via PVCE (PaperJSX Visual Chart Engine). Requires `sharp` as a peer dep for PNG export (`npm install sharp`).

## Public API

```ts
renderToDocx(input, options?)      // { buffer, warnings }
validateDocxDocument(input)        // throws ZodError if invalid
validateDocxBuffer(buffer)         // post-emit Word-strict OOXML checks
setDeterministicMode(true)         // stable ZIP dates, rel IDs, RSIDs, generated IDs
scanForPlaceholders(templateBuffer)
hydrateDocx(templateBuffer, data, options?)

// Errors
DOCXError                          // { code, message, suggestion, path }
PolyglotErrorCollector             // non-fatal warning accumulator
```

Full type surface in `dist/index.d.ts`.

## Themes

Six built-in themes control default fonts, heading sizes, link colors, and table styling:

```ts
renderToDocx({ ...doc, theme: "modern" });
```

Presets: `corporate`, `modern`, `academic`, `classic`, `minimal`, `dark`. Each theme is a JSON object and can be cloned and overridden.

## Error Handling

```ts
import { DOCXError } from "@paperjsx/json-to-docx";

try {
  const { buffer, warnings } = await renderToDocx(doc);
  if (warnings.length) {
    for (const w of warnings) console.warn(w.code, w.message);
  }
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof DOCXError) {
    console.error(err.code, err.message, "at", err.path, "→", err.suggestion);
  }
  throw err;
}
```

`DOCXError` carries a stable error code, the offending document path, and a remediation hint. Non-fatal issues are surfaced through `warnings[]` instead of throwing.

## Security

- All remote image URLs pass through an SSRF guard (private IP blocklist, scheme allowlist, DNS timeout).
- Text is sanitized for null bytes, forbidden control characters, NaN/Infinity.
- Tree depth capped at 100, text length capped at 1MB per run. Coordinate values clamped to safe ranges.

## Upgrade to Pro

`@paperjsx/json-to-docx-pro` adds:

- commercial / self-hosted production license
- visual polish (design tokens, shadow physics, gradients, ICC color profiles)
- compliance validation (Indian GST, EU reverse charge, Brazilian DANFE)
- SecurePDF: password protection, permissions, merging
- font subsetting via `opentype.js`
- tracked changes / compare flows

Identical API — swap the import and provide a license key.
